title: Enrollment Fees Counted in the Catastrophic Total of a TRICARE Select Cap-Reprocessed Line
content:
**Adjudication rule.** Where the **TRICARE Select** tier's enrollment fees count toward the catastrophic cap and the payments posted on the fee account cover the installments whose coverage period has begun, those installments are added to the family catastrophic total of a cap-reprocessed line in full; where fees count and some but less has been paid, the payments posted are added; otherwise no enrollment fee is added.

An installment's coverage period has begun when it starts on or before the adjudication date (the fee account is read back over 600 months).

| Tier | Fees count toward the cap |
|---|---|
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-1 to E-4), Group A (E-5 and Above), Group B (E-1 to E-4) and Group B (E-5 and Above) | no (fee-exempt) |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group A | yes |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group B | yes |

## Input - judgement - output (hypothetical, TRICARE Select Retiree Group B, annual family installment 1190.16 begun)

- Paid 1190.16: the installment is covered; 1190.16 is added.
- Paid 500.00: some but less; 500.00 is added.
- Paid nothing: nothing is added.
